text:
alex: quick sync hey team planning the 'responsiveness vs spend' benchmark reveal. goal: one hero visual, three microcards, and a short webinar. need alignment on framing.

priya: framing: position for product PMs first (predictable monthly spend) then a short ops section (how to tune latency/cost).

juan: agree. hero should be a clean scatter: x = median latency (ms), y = $/1k tokens, size = throughput footprint. annotate a "sweet spot" box and show an inset bar for batching+cache delta.

abby: throwing rough layout numbers for the mockup. treat as layout only, not final metrics.

abby: ```
model,median_ms,$_per_1k,use_case
red-8k,58,0.052,chat
red-13b-opt,132,0.075,search
open-12b-q3,95,0.047,rerank
mini-gpt,260,0.14,batch
```

claire: copy variants we should A/B: H1: "Predictable spend, reliable UX" H2: "Tune serving: cut spend, keep responsiveness". landing CTA test: download kit vs register webinar.

alex: webinar plan: 18m demo (cache+batching knobs), 12m short customer story, 15m Q&A. CTA: download the benchmark kit (config + data) + try Dedicated trial.

juan: design asks: hero PNG 1200x628, small-multiples for three use-cases, animated GIF showing p95 improvement after KV caching. also need a tiny methodology callout.

abby: methodology snippet we can use: "Measurements are median and p95 over 30m steady-state at 50-200 qps. cost model includes batching, KV prefix cache, and model runtime. anonymized customer runs included."

priya: routing rules draft: webinar signups with team_size>30 -> AE queue; kit downloads with company domain -> SDR; all others -> nurture (3-email). also capture primary_use_case on form.

claire: social plan: teaser card on Tues, launch post + hero on Wed, short demo clip on Thurs. track headline variant and kit-download->trial conversion as primary KPI.

juan: quick note on axes: use log scale for latency if we include mini-gpt point, else linear. prefer log so differences are visible.

abby: small supporting stats to callout on the page: prefix-cache = ~22% token reduction on search slice; batching at 150 qps = ~17% cost reduction. i'll validate and upload the final CSV.

alex: messaging tests: variant A (cost-first) and variant B (latency-first). we'll A/B subject and hero headline. follow-up email tailored by the selected primary_use_case.

priya: for the hero legend, color by use-case (chat=blue, search=green, rerank=purple, batch=grey) and add dashed SLA line at 150ms median.

claire: design timeline: comps by Fri EOD, animated GIF by Mon AM. can we get numbers locked by Thu noon?

juan: i'll run one more sweep and post final CSV by Thu 11:30 PST.

abby: action list: juan -> final CSV, claire -> hero comps, priya -> routing + form, alex -> draft launch copy and webinar landing.

bench-bot: bench-run-5523 complete. artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/5523/preview.png and s3://redwood-bench/5523/data.csv :white_check_mark:

alex: love it. i'll draft two hero headlines and the short blog snippet once the final CSV is in. catchups async unless anyone objects to the routing thresholds. :rocket:
